annotationRationale: Integrality and prime divisibility force the common radical form. Completing the square then locates the quadratic minimum subject to the integer restriction.
sourceMethod: Followed the official reduction to x=7a^2, y=7b^2 with a+b=13, followed by quadratic minimization. Supplied the missing justification for the radical forms and used a completed square to display the minimum.

review.mathCheck: Since 1183=7·13², isolating and squaring makes √(7x) rational, hence integral. Prime divisibility gives x=7a² and y=7(13−a)² for integers 1≤a≤12. Thus x+y=14(a−6.5)²+591.5, minimized at a=6 or 7. The minimum 595 is attained by (252,343), confirming B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 13, page 6: common-radical parametrization followed by quadratic minimization at the nearest integers to 6.5. The candidate supplies the official solution's implicit integrality justification and checks attainment in the original equation.
review.annotationCheck: All five direct nodes are used. Radical equations, integer restrictions and quadratic extrema are appropriately assessed; prime-factor structure and completing the square provide support. No material gap or incorrect selection.
